messages:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up — after our customer's Okta org merge, ~120 users still show in the Okta group but their Redwood roles were removed. SCIM connector reports success (200) on group PATCH but role mapping didn't run. Example user: okta|alice.smith (uid: 00u1abcd), affected group: Engineering-Redwood (okta_group_id: 00g5xyz). Anyone seen externalId namespace shifts cause this?

Mira Chen: Can you paste the raw SCIM patch payload and the connector log lines around the patch? Also which connector version?

Alex Rivera: Connector: 2.8.1, connector-id: conn-77. Curl payload below from the customer's audit:

```json
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/00g5xyz
Content-Type: application/scim+json
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]

{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"00u1abcd","display":"alice.smith","type":"User","$ref":"/scim/v2/Users/00u1abcd","externalId":"okta:00u1abcd"}]}]}
```

Mira Chen: In the logs I see the group externalId previously was "ext:00g5xyz" on our side, but Okta now sends "okta:00g5xyz" after the merge. Our group->role lookup uses group.externalId as the key, so the namespace changed and we never reconciled the mapping — hence roles didn't reapply. Do you have pre-merge externalId values?

Alex Rivera: Yes — pre-merge externalId for that group in our DB: "ext:00g5xyz". After merge: Okta pushes "okta:00g5xyz". The connector returned 200 for PATCH but our mapping code does a lookup by externalId only.

Jen Patel: That matches a class of issues we've seen: namespace normalization on the IdP side after org merge. Quick mitigation: run a reconcile that maps both prefixes for the group. We can also update the sync job to try lookup by short id (strip prefix) when externalId mismatch.

Samir Khatri: For immediate customer fix, ops can run:

```bash
# idempotent reapply for a single group
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/admin/scim/reconcile-group" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"group_id":"00g5xyz","externalId_alternatives":["ext:00g5xyz","okta:00g5xyz","00g5xyz"]}'
```

Jen Patel: Also add this small migration to map existing group.externalId values that start with known legacy prefixes. Sample SQL:

```sql
UPDATE scim_groups
SET external_id = regexp_replace(external_id, '^ext:', 'okta:')
WHERE external_id LIKE 'ext:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_mappings rm WHERE rm.group_external_id = 'okta:' || substring(external_id from 5));
```

Alex Rivera: Trying the reconcile now on a small subset. Will report back.

scim-bot: automated note — reconcile job queued (job_id: job-8821) by Alex Rivera. ETA ~ 90s.

OpsBot: Heads-up @Jen Patel @Samir Khatri — ran reconcile on 3 test users, roles reapplied for the test accounts. :white_check_mark:

Jen Patel: Great. Post-mortem action items: 1) Connector release note to preserve original externalId namespace where possible; 2) Add fallback lookup by stripped id; 3) Add alert for group externalId drift during org merge flows.

Alex Rivera: Thanks everyone — forwarding resolution steps to customer and asking them to run an org-wide reconcile. Will re-open if it doesn't hold. :thumbsup:
